PASS_POINTS: V3 binds exact Universe V3 and adapter blob identities instead of hardcoding Universe V1.
open_control_p0_count is inside the projected root object and validators must recompute it.
External severity/status taxonomies are removed from the projection authority path.
Known exact P0 severities cannot be downgraded.
Dedup parents must be same-snapshot P0 CONTROL_BLOCKER rows and an open supporting row cannot hide behind a terminal parent.

BLOCKING_FINDINGS.ISSUE: CLASSIFICATION_MANIFEST and DEDUP_DECISION_MANIFEST define root hash shapes but no canonical repository roots, source-record enumeration contract, path rules, or completeness proof for the records that must enter each manifest.
BLOCKING_FINDINGS.COUNTEREXAMPLE: At one pinned control tree, projector A can include all classification records while projector B omits one conflicting highest-generation record. Both can hash a syntactically valid manifest under the current text, but they can produce different p0/control relevance and a different zero result.
REQUIRED_REPAIR: Define exact canonical roots/locator manifests for semantic classification and dedup decision records.
Account every candidate record at the pinned control tree exactly once, including parse/conflict rows.
Bind manifest source-tree/root identity and completeness summary into each manifest root.
Fail closed on omitted, duplicate, malformed, unaccounted, or conflicting records.

BLOCKING_FINDINGS.ISSUE: PROJECTED_MANIFEST lists PROJECTED_ROW_FIELDS but defines no PROJECTED_ROW_TYPES/null rules. status_valid is emitted but has no exact derivation anywhere in V3, and classification_record_id/generation/canonical_blocker_id/dedup_decision_id nullability is not closed.
BLOCKING_FINDINGS.COUNTEREXAMPLE: Two validators can encode an absent classification_record_id as null versus an empty string, or disagree on status_valid for a malformed/non-NFC status_raw, while all root-level FIELD_TYPES still appear satisfied because rows are only described as 'projected_row'.
REQUIRED_REPAIR: Define exact type/null contract for every projected row field.
Define status_valid mechanically and bind terminal_nonblocking derivation to it.
Forbid omitted/extra projected-row keys and define row normalization before JCS.

BLOCKING_FINDINGS.ISSUE: If multiple highest-generation VALID semantic classification records agree on override/control_relevance, V3 does not select one deterministically even though the projected row contains one classification_record_id. The same ambiguity exists for multiple same-generation valid dedup decisions that resolve to the same parent but have different decision IDs/evidence.
BLOCKING_FINDINGS.COUNTEREXAMPLE: Two generation-7 PASS-reviewed classification records for the same finding both say P0 + CONTROL_BLOCKER but have IDs A and B. They do not 'disagree' semantically, so projection may remain VALID, yet one projector emits A and another B, changing CONTROL_P0_SET_ROOT_HASH.
REQUIRED_REPAIR: Require exactly one highest-generation valid record per finding/decision key, or define a deterministic tie-break and hash-bind the full agreeing record set.
Treat multiple same-generation records as UNKNOWN_BLOCKING unless uniqueness is proven by a CAS-governed record-generation authority.

BLOCKING_FINDINGS.ISSUE: Classification/dedup manifest ROOT_HASH expressions include rows but the semantic record schemas declare only REQUIRED_FIELDS and do not define an exact normalized manifest-row field set, extra-field policy, or row object projection.
BLOCKING_FINDINGS.COUNTEREXAMPLE: Two manifest generators reading one record containing an additional audit field can hash the full object versus hash only required fields; both behaviors are not excluded by the current schema.
REQUIRED_REPAIR: Define exact manifest row fields/types/null rules and forbid extra keys in the authoritative row projection, or hash immutable source blob identities instead of re-materialized record objects.
Define deterministic record row ordering after the exact normalization projection.

INHERITED_BLOCKER: Projection V3 binds Universe V3 and Adapter V1 exact blobs that are independently CHANGES_REQUIRED under F-V16RC13-P0PIPE-V3-DETERMINISM-6A13C4F2; therefore Projection V3 cannot be adopted while those bound inputs remain rejected.
